summary: According to warning information, having diarrhea or vomiting may reduce how well the body absorbs atovaquone, and patients who are vomiting should have the parasite levels in their blood closely tracked while considering anti-vomiting medicine [3]. For patients who have severe or long-lasting diarrhea or vomiting, alternative treatments should be used [3]. In addition, a small computer model—not tests done on people—gave Proguanil low risk scores of 32 for the liver and 49 for the heart [M].
